correctness.rationale: The spectral decomposition equivalence, closedness from finite coefficient-curve map, irreducibility via triangular conjugation, \(n^2-n+1\) dimensions from complete flags and companion cyclic orbits, distinct component criterion and exact common nilpotent cone are proved for algebraically closed K in any characteristic. Counts use unique rational generalized eigenspaces and \(q^{s^2-s}\) nilpotent counts. Fixed-q asymptotic is a uniformly bounded product-ratio sum. Seven exhaustive prime-field cases replayed, without conflating finite verification and proof.

value.rationale: The entire locus of recently defined commuting quasi-idempotent plus nilpotent matrices has a natural, complete, dimension-uniform geometric classification: exactly n equidimensional irreducible components, pairwise intersection precisely the nilpotent cone of codimension one. It makes a global reducibility and degeneration structure explicit rather than isolating a small arbitrary numerical case. Classical-derived finite-field enumerations and sharp fixed-q density support applicability but are not used to claim original counting methods.
